config.name: Davanagere branch, one quarter
config.note: The seeded demo scenario. Every number the story prints comes from running this; nothing here is an output.

shocks.why: m010 sits in k2, the kendra with the highest R potential, so the shock lands where the network says it would spread furthest. Severity is the params.py default for a health shock. Duration 6 (default 4) and start week 3 (was 2) came out of scripts/tune_demo.py: a longer illness gives her peers more meetings at which to cover her, which took the three transmitted peers from 12 to 23 of 50 reruns to 22 to 28 of 50 without any member override. The target of 35 of 50 was not reached by any shock or buffer input in the search; see NEXT.md.

config.decision_week_why: The illness starts in week 3, the officer hears about it at that meeting and can act by week 4. Acting in week 1 would be clairvoyant, and a fix from week 9 or later could not be judged inside the horizon.

officer_note.text: {name} is unwell and mostly off work since last week. She paid her installment in full today, but out of her savings.
officer_note.why: Read out at the decision week meeting. It must match the run: through week 4 the index member pays in full with no cover and no arrears, while her savings fall by more than four fifths. Her first short payment is in week 5. build_story recomputes that, and a test fails if the note stops being true.
